summary: Cloud KMS provides a library conforming to the PKCS #11 standard for use with existing PKCS #11 applications.
extended_definition: Cloud KMS provides a library conforming to the PKCS #11 standard for use with existing PKCS #11 applications.

supporting_pages.title: "Use Jsign and PKCS#11 to sign Windows artifacts \_|\_ Cloud Key Management\
evidence_snippets: In the Cloud KMS PKCS #11 library, the key label is equivalent to the CryptoKey name. openssl req -new -x509 -days 3650 -subj '/CN=test/' -sha256 -engine pkcs11 \ -keyform engine -key pkcs11:object= KEY NAME > ca.cert If this command fails, PKCS11 MODULE PATH may have been set incorrectly, or you might not have the right permissions to use the Cloud KMS signing key.

Using Cloud Shell or your own machine, run the following command: openssl req -new -subj '/CN= CERTIFICATE NAME /' DIGEST FLAG \ -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine \ -key pkcs11:id= KEY ID > REQUEST NAME .csr Replace the following: CERTIFICATE NAME : a name for the certificate that you want to generate.

supporting_pages.title: "Use a Cloud HSM key with pkcs11-tool \_|\_ Cloud Key Management Service\
evidence_snippets: This guide provides sample pkcs11-tool commands to use a Cloud HSM key on Debian 11 (Bullseye) using the PKCS #11 library.

Decrypt To decrypt a text file, run the following command: pkcs11 - tool -- module PATH TO LIBKMSP11 SO \ -- decrypt -- mechanism RSA - PKCS - OAEP -- slot 0 -- hash - algorithm = sha256 \ -- mgf MGF1 - SHA256 -- label HSM KEY NAME -- type privkey \ - i ENCRYPTED TEXT FILE PATH \ - o OUTPUT TEXT FILE PATH Replace the following: PATH TO LIBKMSP11 SO : the path to the PKCS#11 module (path/to/libkmsp11.so).

Decrypt To decrypt a text file, run the following command: pkcs11-tool --module PATH TO LIBKMSP11 SO --decrypt \ --mechanism MECHANISM \ --slot 0 \ --label HSM KEY NAME \ --iv INITIALIZATION VECTOR \ --input-file ENCRYPTED TEXT FILE PATH \ --output-file DECRYPTED TEXT FILE PATH Replace the following: PATH TO LIBKMSP11 SO : the path to the PKCS#11 module—for example, /usr/local/lib/libkmsp11.so .

supporting_pages.title: "Use a Cloud HSM key to serve Apache traffic \_|\_ Cloud Key Management Service\
evidence_snippets: In the Cloud KMS PKCS #11 library, the key label is the CryptoKey name. openssl req -new -x509 -days 3650 -subj '/CN= CERTIFICATE NAME /' \ DIGEST FLAG -engine pkcs11 -keyform engine \ -key PKCS KEY TYPE = KEY IDENTIFIER > PATH TO CERTIFICATE Replace the following: CERTIFICATE NAME : a name for the certificate.
GRPC ENABLE FORK SUPPORT is needed for gRPC to include fork support and correctly run the Cloud KMS PKCS #11 library as part of the Apache server.

Add the following lines to the end of the file: export PKCS11 MODULE PATH = "<var>PATH TO LIBKMSP11</var>" export KMS PKCS11 CONFIG = "<var>PATH TO PKCS11 CONFIG</var>" export GRPC ENABLE FORK SUPPORT = 1 Replace the following: PATH TO LIBKMSP11 : the path to libkmsp11.so .
